preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is at least 1.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= n <= 100 for n in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case has 3 ≤ n ≤ 100 players to select.
The sum of squares of the values of n over all test cases does not exceed 10,000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(selected_players) == n for n, selected_players in zip(test_cases, selected_players_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case, exactly n players are selected.

postconditions.expression: all(len(matches) <= 4 * n**2 for n, matches in zip(test_cases, matches_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the number of matches does not exceed 4n^2.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(selected_players)) == n for selected_players in selected_players_list)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the selected players are distinct.
For each test case, there are at least two possible orderings of the selected n players by strength.
For each test case, there is exactly one way to choose n players with the highest strength.
